mission_09: The bidirectional encoder processes the input sequence in both directions and concatenates the forward and backward hidden states at each time step.
Bahdanau attention computes scores as v^T tanh(W_enc * h_enc + W_dec * h_dec), then applies softmax to get attention weights over encoder positions.
The decoder combines the previous token embedding with the attention context vector, updates its state through a GRU-style transition, and projects to vocabulary logits.
